name: Berserk
effectLabel: If one or more Effects are rolled when the weapon deals damage, the target flies into a rage and attacks the nearest living creature (friend or foe) until the end of the scene.

name: Bleed-Out
effectLabel: The weapon gains the Persistent Damage quality.

name: Bloatfly Larva
effectLabel: If one or more Effects are rolled when the weapon deals damage, a Bloatfly emerges from the target's remains when it dies.

name: Endangerol
effectLabel: If one or more Effects are rolled when the weapon deals damage, the target's Physical Damage resistance is reduced by 2 until the end of the scene.

name: Lock Joint
effectLabel: The weapon gains the Stun quality.

name: Mind Cloud
effectLabel: If one or more Effects are rolled when the weapon deals damage, the target is confused: +2 difficulty to all END tests for a number of rounds equal to the number of Effects rolled.

name: Pax
effectLabel: If one or more Effects are rolled when the weapon deals damage, the target cannot take hostile or aggressive actions for a number of rounds equal to the number of Effects rolled.

name: Radscorpion Venom
effectLabel: The weapon deals +1 CD damage and gains the Persistent (Poison) quality.

name: Yellow Belly
effectLabel: If one or more Effects are rolled, the target must spend at least one action each turn moving away from all enemies by the shortest route, for a number of rounds equal to the number of Effects rolled.
